title: A1.2 — Past Tenses, Present Perfect, & Daily Life
description: Talk about your past experiences, daily routines, and handle everyday situations like shopping, dining, and describing the weather.

themes.title: Daily Routines
themes.description: Describe your daily schedule using reflexive verbs and time expressions. Learn the vocabulary for morning and evening routines.

themes.title: Demonstratives and Possessives
themes.description: Learn to point things out and show ownership — este/ese/aquel and mi/tu/su.

themes.title: Education & School
themes.description: Learn to talk about school, subjects, studying, exams, and academic life in Spanish.

themes.title: Entertainment & Leisure
themes.description: Learn to talk about hobbies, entertainment, free time activities, sports, and how you spend your leisure time in Spanish.

themes.title: Health & Body
themes.description: Learn to talk about body parts, describe symptoms, visit the doctor, and understand basic health expressions in everyday situations.

themes.title: Preterite — Irregular Verbs
themes.description: Learn the high-frequency irregular preterite verbs: ESTAR, IR, HACER, TENER, and DECIR.

themes.title: Shopping & Prices
themes.description: Learn to shop in Spanish, ask about prices, compare products, and handle transactions at stores and markets.

themes.title: Social Interactions
themes.description: Learn to greet, introduce yourself, show politeness, express feelings, and handle common social situations in Spanish.

themes.title: Travel & Transportation
themes.description: Learn to talk about transportation, book tickets, navigate airports and stations, handle travel situations, and communicate about itineraries and accommodations.

themes.title: Work & Jobs
themes.description: Learn to talk about jobs, workplaces, hiring, professional life, and employment-related situations in Spanish.
